generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Launch late 2021 as MY2022 (Dream Edition, then Grand Touring, Touring, Pure, Sapphire). 900 V-class architecture; packs differ by trim (powertrains). Native CCS1 port on every model year so far; from July 31, 2025 all Air years can use Superchargers through a NACS-to-CCS1 DC adapter, capped at 50 kW there. 2026 updates (range, quieter cabin) do not change the platform. Peak DC reported as 250 kW (Touring, Electrek) to 300+ kW (GT); figures conflict. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://electrek.co/2025/07/22/lucid-launches-2026-air-ev-lineup-more-range-quieter-expensive/ ; https://lucidmotors.com/stories/2026-lucid-air-tesla-superchargers ; https://www.kbb.com/car-news/2026-lucid-air-gains-range-tesla-charger-access
